title: Privacy notice | Nazryx
description: How Nazryx handles the details you send through this website, and how our anonymous analytics work.

sections.title: Your details,
sections.accent: used only to work with you.
sections.lede: This notice covers the details you send through nazryx.com and the anonymous analytics on the site.

items.title: Market-read requests
items.text: Your name, company, work email, phone (optional), markets of interest and, if you send one, your product list.

items.title: Checklist requests
items.text: Your name, company and work email.

items.title: Messages
items.text: Whatever you send us by email, phone or WhatsApp.

items.title: To reply to you
items.text: We use your details to answer your request and, if you ask, to prepare a market read.

items.title: Kept confidential
items.text: Your product list is used only to read the market for you. It is not shared with anyone else.

items.title: Never sold
items.text: We do not sell, rent or pass on your details.

items.title: No cookies
items.text: Our analytics set no cookies and store no identifiers in your browser beyond a 'seen before' flag.

items.title: No IP addresses
items.text: We do not store IP addresses. Visits are counted with a key that changes every day and cannot be traced back.

items.title: 13 months
items.text: Raw visit data is kept for 13 months, then reduced to daily totals.

items.title: See it
items.text: Ask what we hold about you.

items.title: Change it
items.text: Ask us to correct anything that is wrong.

items.title: Delete it
items.text: Ask us to delete your details. We will confirm when it is done.

sections.title: Questions about your data?
sections.text: Email contact@nazryx.com. We reply within one working day.
